# World Smith

> > World Smith provides resources and guidance for round-the-world (RTW) trip planning and travel preparation.

World Smith specializes in helping travelers plan and prepare for round-the-world trips through structured email series and countdown-based planning tools. The site focuses on systematic travel preparation methodologies for long-term international travel.

## Key Topics

- RTW (Round-the-World Travel)
- Trip Planning
- Travel Preparation
- Countdown Email Series
- Email-Based Travel Guidance
- Long-Term Travel
- International Trip Planning
- Travel Countdown Tools

## Travel Planning Resources

- [RTW Trip Countdown Email Series](https://www.world-smith.com/rtw-trip-countdown-email-series): Structured countdown email series to guide travelers through round-the-world trip planning and preparation phases
